response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(address_count * 1.0) FROM counts) AS relative_to_average, address_count * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM address) AS share_of_total FROM counts ORDER BY share_of_total DESC, city_id LIMIT 10
